svg.title: Reveal the pumps — 50 m neighborhoods
svg.desc: Reveal the pumps — 50 m neighborhoods. 250 recorded locations represent 489 deaths in this teaching dataset. Eight pump locations are shown as diamonds P1 to P8. No population-adjusted risk, causal inference or forecast is shown.
svg.text: Historical teaching data • one dot = one recorded location • not a disease-risk map
Geographic point map, no street basemap. Display uses approximate local meters; fitting uses haversine.
Data: PHI-Case-Studies contributors. Source revision and GPL-3.0 notice: data/cholera/.
